headline: Carrick includes Martínez in squad; Madrid call for Tebas to quit over Goebbels comparison: football news – as it happened
body: Michael Carrick said Manchester United have moved on from Martínezgate, while Enzo Maresca feels ‘no stress’ over Manchester City’s off-field strife Sky are reporting that Reece James, who Chelsea confirmed this morning had undergone minor knee surgery, is expected to be out for three months. Fulham fans fretting about life under Álvaro Arbeloa will not feel any better when they remember how things were under Marco Silva, who was one of the most effective managers in the Premier League when it came to making substitutions. Silva’s substitutes were involved in the fourth-highest goal contributions last season and the most in the 2024-25 season. Fulham knew how to dig in and salvage unlikely points. But Silva left last summer, joining Benfica after concluding he could achieve nothing more at Craven Cottage, and his replacement is already under pressure after some puzzling tactical choices.
